title: Myth & State - New GodSim, Strategy, Economy, Political, GrandStrategy Game!
author: Neat_Jackfruit_2200
selftext:
Hi everyone! I'm a latino university student developing Myth & State, an indie historical society sandbox inspired by Age of Conflict, Victoria, and Europa Universalis, with assistance from Claude AI. It combines world-building and nation management with an emphasis on economics, social classes, cultures, religions, and political systems. It's still in development, with lots of systems and UIs waiting to be polished. I'm mostly baseing it on stuff I have been studying in life and classes, like Marx, Engels, Bourdieu and Levi-Strauss!!

Gameplay Trailer: [https://youtu.be/2QYp7qs8KR0](https://youtu.be/2QYp7qs8KR0)

YouTube Channel: [https://www.youtube.com/@MythAndState](https://www.youtube.com/@MythAndState)

Itch.io: [Myth & State by Myth & State - Dev](https://tarozato.itch.io/myth-state)

I'm working on the game with limited resources, so feedback, financial help, and community support are greatly appreciated :) 

About AI using: I don't know how to code, so AI (OPUS5.5) is being used to code the ideas and mechanics I plan.

I am looking for Alpha Testers who has experience with those kind of games so I can have some feedback! If interested, here is the Discord server link:
